content: Pwutak loalokong men kin rong eh pahpa ni eh kin kapwungohng, a aramas aklapalap oh au laud men sohte kin wehkada me e sapwung.
Aramas mwahu kan pahn ale katingpen ar lokaia kan, ahpw aramas widing kan kin ngoangki tiahk eikek.
Kanahieng omw lokaia oh doarehla omw mour. Me koasoakoasoi mwahl kin kauwehla pein ih.
Aramas pohnkahke men kak inengieng mehkot, ahpw e sohte mwahn pahn ale. A aramas men me kin doadoahk laud pahn ale mehkoaros me e kin anahne.
Aramas lelepek kin kailongki lokaia likamw, ahpw koasoien me suwed men kin kanamenek oh kin kihsang wauwi.
Pwung kin perehla me mwakelekel kan, ahpw suwed kin kesehdi me dipan akan.
Ekei aramas kin mwomwehda kepwehpwe, ahpw sohte ar mehkot. Ekei kin mwomwehda semwehmwe, ahpw re kin ahneki dipwisou tohto.
Aramas kepwehpwe men kin doadoahngki nah mwohni pwehn doarehla eh mour, ahpw sohte me kin men kamasak me semwehmwe men.
Me pwung kan rasehng marain ehu me kin lingaling mwahu, ahpw me suwed akan rasehng lamp me mpwule kin kohkohdi en kunla.
Aramas aklapalap kin kahrehdahte kahpwal. Ahpw me kin peki kaweid, ih me loalokong.
Uwen mengeien omw alehdi omw kepwehpwe, iei uwen mwadang en eh pahn salongala. Ahpw uwen apwal en omw alehdi, iei uwen lauden mwohni me ke pahn naineki.
Ni ahnsou me omw koapworopwor kin ohla, mohngiongomw pil kin ohla; ahpw ni ahnsou me omw ineng kin pweida, met kin audehkihda mohngiongomw koapworopwor.
Ni omw kin soikala kaweid mwahu, ke kin peki kahpwal; a ma ke idawehnla kaweid mwahu, ke pahn poadoandoarla.
Padahk en me loalokong kan iei poahsoan en mour, rasehng utuhnpihl ehu; re pahn kin seweseiuk pwe ke en pitla ma omw mour pahn lelohng kahpwal.
Aramas kin wauneki loalokong; ahpw aramas me sohte likilikparail mie, re miher pohn ahl me kowohng kaupahr.
Aramas me mie eh lamalam men kin medemedewe mwohn eh pahn wia mehkot; ahpw me soaloalokong men kin kalohkiseli pein eh pweipwei.
Sounkair kan me aramas sohte kak likih kin kahrehda kahpwal, ahpw irail me aramas kak likih kin kahrehda popohl.
Mehmen me sohte pahn padahngki mehkot uhdahn pahn semwehmwe oh sohte pahn wauwi. Ahpw mehmen me kin rong peneu kan, wauwi pahn mie.
Ia uwen mwahu en omw pahn alehdi ineng en nan kapehdomw! Aramas pweipwei kan sohte kin men sohpeisang me suwed.
Ma ke pahn padahngki mehkot sang rehn me loalokong kan, ke pahn pil loalokongla. A ma ke pahn kompoakepahnki me pweipwei kan, ke pahn ohkihla.
Kahpwal kin idawehnla me dipan akan wasa koaros, ahpw me pwung kan pahn ale ketingparail ni mehkot mwahu.
E pahn mie en aramas mwahu men eh kepwe me e phn kihong nein nah seri kan en sohsohki, ahpw en me dipan akan kepwe pahn kohieng me pwung kan.
Mwaht me sohte me koadoahki kak kihda mehn komour laud ong me semwehmwe kan, ahpw aramas suwed kin kolokol pwe en dehr koadoahkda.
Ma ke sohte pahn kaloke noumw seri, eri, ke sohte poakepoake. Ma ke poakepoake, ke pahn kapwungala.
Kenen aramas pwung kan kisin mwenge kin itarohng irail, ahpw me suwed kan kin duhpek ahnsou koaros.
